descriptionChirho: An adverb indicating similarity of action or manner; 'in the same way,' 'similarly,' 'likewise.' Greek ὡσαύτως (from ὡς + αὐτός + -ως) marks parallelism between actions or behaviors. Multilingual evidence is identical across both clusters: eng 'likewise / in-same-way,' spa 'igualmente / del-mismo-modo,' hin वैसे ही / उसी प्रकार, arb كَذٰلِكَ (kadhālika, thus/likewise), kor 마찬가지로 (machan-gajiro), swa 'vivyo hivyo' (in the same manner). The two clusters represent the same adverbial sense with trivially different phrasing in English glosses.
